description: This file implements acceleration enrichment calculations for a fuel management system, including strategies for MAP rate-of-change, TPS rate-of-change, and wall fuel correction. It defines classes such as WallFuel and AccelEnrichmemnt, with methods for adjusting fuel based on engine parameters, managing internal data buffers, and logging debug information.

classes.name: WallFuel
classes.description: Handles fuel wall correction calculations, managing last known wall fuel amounts and computing adjustments based on engine and wall parameters.

classes.name: AccelEnrichmemnt
classes.description: Manages acceleration enrichment logic, including methods for fetching max delta values, calculating TPS and engine load-based enrichment, and handling internal buffer states.

methods.name: WallFuel::reset
methods.description: Resets the wall fuel array to zero.

methods.name: WallFuel::adjust
methods.description: Calculates and returns the commanded fuel mass correction based on wall fuel, RPM, and other parameters.

methods.name: WallFuel::getWallFuel
methods.description: Returns the current wall fuel amount for a specific injector.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::getMaxDeltaIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the maximum rate of change in the enrichment buffer.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::getMaxDelta
methods.description: Calculates the maximum delta based on the buffer's maximum rate of change.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::getTpsEnrichment
methods.description: Computes enrichment based on TPS rate of change.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::reset
methods.description: Resets internal buffers and state variables.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::setLength
methods.description: Sets the buffer size for acceleration data.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::onNewValue
methods.description: Adds a new acceleration value to the buffer.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::onEngineCycleTps
methods.description: Records a new TPS value each engine cycle.

methods.name: AccelEnrichmemnt::onEngineCycle
methods.description: Records a new engine load value each engine cycle.
